+import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
+
+const pages = [
+  '/approvals',
+  '/checkpoints',
+  '/files',
+  '/issues',
+  '/linter',
+  '/graph-builder',
+  '/data-store',
+]
+
+test.describe('HP09 Satellite pages', () => {
+  for (const path of pages) {
+    test(`smoke ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {
+      await test.step(`navigate ${path}`, async () => {
+        const res = await page.goto(path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' })
+        expect(res).toBeTruthy()
+      })
+      await test.step('body visible', async () => {
+        await expect(page.locator('body')).toBeVisible()
+      })
+    })
+  }
+})
A  e2e/happy-path/hp09-satellite.spec.ts

+name: e2e-happy-path
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [master, main]
+    paths:
+      - 'e2e/**'
+      - 'playwright.config.ts'
+      - 'packages/web/**'
+      - 'package.json'
+  pull_request:
+    paths:
+      - 'e2e/**'
+      - 'playwright.config.ts'
+      - 'packages/web/**'
+      - 'package.json'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+jobs:
+  happy-path:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '20'
+          cache: npm
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Run happy-path e2e
+        run: npm run test:e2e
+        env:
+          CI: true
